title: Count Good Nodes In Binary Tree
prompt: Given a binary tree root, a node X in the tree is named good if in the path from root to X there are no nodes with a value greater than X. Return the number of good nodes in the binary tree.
hints: DFS: pass the maximum value seen so far in the path. At each node, if node.val >= maxSoFar, it's good. Update maxSoFar for children.
Base: null returns 0. Count = 1 if good, else 0. Add recursive counts from left and right with updated max.
